title: Held-out arena size for the Lenia predator (pre-registered): at 240^2 the predator survives 630 t after introduction on seed 3 (prediction: >= 500 t on at least one of two seeds, met) and 270 t on seed 4, so 224-240^2 is the transition band where persistence is a coin flip
summary: Pre-registered in 20261026T0131-c26-intent-predator-240 before running: at 240^2, between the 224^2 split and the 256^2 runs (710-940 t) of 20261026T0100-c26-predator-persistence-sizes, the specialist predator should survive >= 500 t after its introduction at t=200 on at least one of two fresh seeds. Same world and parameters (20261026T0003-c26-lenia-predator-arena/world.py, WORLD_P {"PRED":1,"T_INTRO":200,"PSIG":8,"DECB":0.002,"DOMAIN":240}), seeds 3 and 4, t=0-900 (data/, runle.py counts). Seed 3: two predator waves (to 20 and 28 cells) with prey cycling 21-54 cells, predator last seen at t=830, 630 t after introduction (p240_s3.png). Seed 4: one wave (to 21 cells), prey down to 30, predator extinct at t=470 (270 t), prey then saturate at 72-75. The prediction holds. Together with the earlier sizes (160-192^2: 80-120 t on 4/4 runs; 224^2: 250 t and >= 1200 t; 256^2: 710-940 t; 320^2: >= 1200 t on 2/2) persistence rises from ~100 t to > 1000 t across a band at about 224-256^2 in which single runs go either way.

finding.operator: predation (matter transfer from prey to predator) between two Lenia replicator species
finding.control: held-out arena size (240^2) predicted before running, fresh seeds 3 and 4
finding.result: persistence after introduction: seed 3 630 t, seed 4 270 t (prediction >= 500 t on >= 1 seed: met)

limits: A weak, one-sided prediction on two seeds; runs end at t=900. This is a band of mixed outcomes, not yet a fitted law; a probability of persistence per size needs about 8 seeds per size.
